The '''TH-16A Tech''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] in usage during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. Used by both [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], the TH-16A bore quite similarities with armorsets such as the [[TT-16A Powered Assault]] and the [[TT-17A Hydra]].
